question: From 2014 the UK chart counted 100 streams as one sale. A song: 4 million streams, 15,000 downloads. Chart sales, in thousands?
answer: 55 thousand sales, almost three-quarters of them from streams
move: Whoever sets the exchange rate between different things decides who wins.
ask: When I compare two very different things, what exchange rate am I quietly using?
trap: Treating every stream as a sale, which gives over 4 million.
hint: Turn the streams into sales first, then add the downloads.
steps: 55 thousand sales, almost three-quarters of them from streams
reference: Official Charts Company, Streaming to count towards the Official Singles Chart, June 2014
